questions.question: How long should a sample soak before it is weighed?
questions.explanation: Ten minutes is long enough for the surface water to drain. A longer soak changes the weight.

questions.question: What goes on the label of every tray?
questions.explanation: Every tray is labelled with its number, so results can be matched to it. Nothing else is needed on the label.

questions.question: What is worn  while cutting stone?
questions.explanation: Safety goggles are worn for every cut.  Gloves are worn only when handling hot samples.

questions.question: What is the weight limit for a hand sample, in grams?
questions.explanation: A hand sample may weigh up to 90 grams. Heavier ones go on the bench scale.

questions.question: Who signs a sample out of the store?
questions.explanation: The shift lead signs it out and writes the time. Visitors never carry samples.

questions.question: What do you call the order in which steps are written in the lab book?
questions.explanation: The written order of steps is the method. A guess has no steps.
